workbook.title: Get Smart Plus 4 Workbook
workbook.prompt: Look at the pictures. What do the children have to do?
workbook.observed_content: Six picture-based household duties; pupils write have to + action sentences. Printed example: They have to water the plants.
workbook.rph_match: Lesson 030 optional Workbook p.14 Activity 1 matches original printed task
workbook.notes: This written Workbook activity is separate from the SB p.20 Activity 2 listening task; it does not resolve which recording matches SB p.20. WB p.15 contains a separate Listen and number task and must not be conflated with WB p.14.
